title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations on campus-adjacent downtown corridors, each with a specific documented purpose.

cards.title: College Avenue: campus-gate bakery stop
cards.subtitle: 110 E. College Ave; College Avenue corridor, across from the Allen Street Gates
cards.notes: Use the College Avenue corner as a bakery-and-café stop, then continue through the Allen Street Gates across the street.
cards.short_summary: A documented café directly opposite the campus gates.
cards.evidence_claim: Irving's identifies its location as 110 E. College Ave at Allen Street, directly across from campus by the Allen Street Gates.
cards.access_notes: Business location; confirm current service details before visiting.

cards.title: College Avenue: see the posted arts program
cards.subtitle: 130 W. College Ave; College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the performance calendar before heading west on College Avenue; the venue lists music, theatre, film, comedy, dance and children’s programming.
cards.short_summary: A community performing-arts venue on the west side of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The State Theatre lists its address at 130 West College Avenue and describes programming including concerts, drama, films, dance, comedy and children’s programming.
cards.access_notes: Box office hours are listed Monday–Friday, noon–5 p.m.; tickets or event policies may apply.

cards.title: South Allen Street: library stop
cards.subtitle: 211 S. Allen St; South Allen Street corridor
cards.notes: Bring reading or research plans to the public library on South Allen Street; check its program calendar and current building access before you go.
cards.short_summary: A public-library destination anchored on South Allen Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Schlow Centre Region Library lists its address as 211 S. Allen Street in State College.
cards.source_title: Schlow Centre Region Library — Virtual Community Rooms
cards.access_notes: Library programming and service availability can vary; consult the library before visiting.

cards.title: East Beaver Avenue: books and plant-based café
cards.subtitle: 133 E. Beaver Ave; East Beaver Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Browse the bookstore and café at 133 East Beaver Avenue; use the Humes Alley ramp entrance if step-free entry is helpful.
cards.short_summary: A bookstore-café with a documented accessible alternate entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Webster's lists 133 E. Beaver Ave, identifies itself as a plant-based café, and directs guests needing a ramp entrance to Humes Alley.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours; verify them before departure.

cards.title: East Beaver Avenue: gallery and community programs
cards.subtitle: 137 E. Beaver Ave; East Beaver Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit during listed open-gallery hours to view art, use the indoor piano, or consult the calendar for an all-ages-appropriate community program.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts space with gallery hours and a public events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: 3 Dots Downtown lists 137 East Beaver Avenue and describes daytime gallery hours plus arts and community programming.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Thursday–Saturday, noon–5 p.m.; individual events may have separate details or charges.

cards.title: East College Avenue: campus supplies retail
cards.subtitle: 414 E. College Ave; East College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this East College Avenue retail stop for campus-oriented merchandise or in-person returns; bring a receipt for return or exchange requests.
cards.short_summary: A documented student-store location with in-person return service.
cards.evidence_claim: McLanahan's lists its State College address as 414 East College Ave and states that returns may be made in person at its store.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchase required for merchandise; return eligibility is subject to the store’s posted policy.

cards.title: East College Avenue: daytime breakfast counter
cards.subtitle: 364 E. College Ave; East College Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a daytime meal stop at the downtown location; its official page lists daily service from 7 a.m. to 2 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown breakfast restaurant with published daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waffle Shop’s official site lists its downtown location at 364 East College Avenue and hours of 7 a.m.–2 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours are daily, 7 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify holiday service before visiting.

cards.title: East College Avenue: grounds and local history
cards.subtitle: 1001 E. College Ave; East College Avenue corridor at Porter Road
cards.notes: Walk the public gardens and interpretive trail signs, or schedule ahead if you want a mansion tour or archive appointment.
cards.short_summary: Historic grounds beside East College Avenue with self-guided outdoor interpretation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Centre County Historical Society locates Centre Furnace Mansion at 1001 East College Avenue and states that its gardens and walking paths are open to the public from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Centre County Historical Society — Visit Us
cards.access_notes: Gardens and paths are open dawn to dusk; tours and archival research require advance arrangements.

cards.title: South Allen Street: observe local government
cards.subtitle: 243 S. Allen St; South Allen Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the borough calendar and attend an announced public council meeting, or use the building as a civic landmark while walking South Allen Street.
cards.short_summary: The borough’s civic building and regular council-meeting site.
cards.evidence_claim: State College Borough lists the Municipal Building at 243 S. Allen Street and schedules Borough Council meetings there on the first and third Monday of each month.
cards.source_title: State College Borough — Borough Council & Mayor
cards.access_notes: Council meeting schedules may be modified; verify the agenda and meeting calendar before attending.

cards.title: East Beaver Avenue: transit information point
cards.subtitle: 108 E. Beaver Ave; East Beaver Avenue corridor, below Schlow Library
cards.notes: Use the customer-service center for fare and pass questions, lost-and-found help, or transit information before heading farther from campus.
cards.short_summary: A staffed downtown transit-information destination beneath the library.
cards.evidence_claim: CATA lists its Customer Service Center at 108 East Beaver Avenue, below Schlow Centre Region Library, with weekday customer-service hours.
cards.access_notes: Customer Service Center hours are Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–6 p.m.; it is closed Saturday and Sunday.
